title: Report: US Suspects Lebanese Security Helping Iranian Guards Enter Lebanon
detail: A US official told reporters that Washington suspects members of Lebanon's General Security are helping Iranian Revolutionary Guard operatives enter Lebanon using fraudulently obtained Lebanese identity documents at Beirut airport and land crossings. The report said the Trump administration is investigating passport-issuance irregularities and alleged coordination with Hezbollah at the airport and port, deepening US scrutiny of Lebanese state institutions amid the broader disarmament push.

media.caption: Report alleges Lebanese security facilitation of Iranian Revolutionary Guard entry, Sep 2, 2026
